compatibility.layout: Page Menu → Share → View More → Add to Home Screen
compatibility.note: First observed on iOS 27 / Safari 27, as reported by the source owner. Reuse this layout for newer versions until a replacement is recorded; newer-version selection is a fallback, not fresh device verification.

steps.title: Open the Page Menu
steps.description: Tap the Page Menu button on the left side of the website address bar. Its icon has three horizontal lines, with a shorter bottom line.

steps.title: Tap Share
steps.description: In the Page Menu, tap Share. Its icon is a square with an arrow pointing upward.

steps.title: Tap View More
steps.description: If the share sheet is collapsed, tap View More, shown with a downward chevron, to reveal the remaining actions. If the action list is already visible, continue to step 4.

steps.title: Tap Add to Home Screen
steps.description: In the expanded action list, find and tap Add to Home Screen. Its icon is a rounded square containing a plus sign.

completion.description: Follow the confirmation screen to finish adding the app.

illustration.alt: Four steps: tap Page Menu beside the address, tap Share, tap View More if needed, then tap Add to Home Screen.
